name: DP World Tamil Nadu logistics data-centre component - Thiruvallur
developer: DP World / Government of Tamil Nadu
notes: Tamil Nadu press reports on the DP World MoU list container terminals at Thiruvallur and other cities, and describe multi-product storage facilities, data centres, a trade zone and related logistics investments. The public reports do not disclose a site-specific data-centre capacity or confirm whether the data-centre element is physically in Thiruvallur.

name: Tuticorin Cable Landing Station / Digital Transmission Centre
notes: Submarine Networks lists the Tuticorin CLS at the Digital Transmission Centre, 145/11 Ettayapuram Road, Tuticorin, owned by BSNL and serving the Bharat Lanka Cable System. Guidance Tamil Nadu also identifies Tuticorin/Thoothukkudi as a subsea cable landing location with about 1 Tbps capacity, but this is a cable/digital transmission centre rather than a disclosed hyperscale compute data centre.

name: DP World Tamil Nadu logistics data-centre component - Thoothukkudi
developer: DP World / Government of Tamil Nadu
notes: Tamil Nadu press reports on the DP World MoU list container terminals at Thoothukkudi and other cities, and describe multi-product storage facilities, data centres, a trade zone and related logistics investments. The public reports do not disclose a site-specific data-centre capacity or confirm whether the data-centre element is physically in Thoothukkudi.

name: Tamil Nadu Disaster Recovery Centre (TNDRC), ELCOSEZ Tiruchirappalli
developer: Electronics Corporation of Tamil Nadu (ELCOT) / Government of Tamil Nadu
notes: Official Tamil Nadu IT department page says TNDRC was established at Thiruchirapalli as a full-fledged disaster recovery centre for critical e-governance applications hosted at TNSDC, designed to Tier II standards and inaugurated on 2017-10-11. DCD reported the project cost as Rs 59.8 crore / about USD 9.2 million.

name: TNPDCL Tirunelveli Regional Data Centre for LT Billing / Project BEST
developer: Tamil Nadu Power Distribution Corporation Limited (TNPDCL, formerly TANGEDCO)
notes: Official TNPDCL tender specification for Tirunelveli Region describes maintenance of servers, SAN, network equipment, UPS, LAN, backup/reporting, 24x7 manpower and VPN links for the Regional Data Centre supporting LT Billing / Project BEST. This is a utility regional data centre, not a disclosed commercial hyperscale facility.

name: TANGEDCO Villupuram Region Data Centre for LT Billing / Project BEST
developer: Tamil Nadu Generation and Distribution Corporation Limited (TANGEDCO)
notes: Tamil Nadu eProcurement search result for CE/D/VPM/OTE NO 14/2020-21 describes maintenance of LT billing connectivity from a data center to locations in Villupuram Region; an older tender aggregator also describes automatic supply changer work for the Villupuram data centre. This appears to be a utility/regional billing data centre, not a commercial hyperscale facility.
